metadata.notes: Official points through the United States GP on 25 October. Yuki Tsunoda is retained in the recruitment pool; the current Racing Bulls starting pair is Lawson/Lindblad. Andrea Kimi Antonelli uses the full FIA name. Race/qualifying/consistency/car ratings are transparent game estimates based on points, not official measurements. Ages, salaries and reliability use game defaults. The mod starts a new championship at zero points and retains the real source standings as reference metadata. Calendar dates are mapped relative to the new career season; omitted unsupported venues are listed explicitly.
